source: Ensure that all doors are closed, the platform is clear, and that the signal ahead showing a Proceed aspect before clearing the train for departure.
Press [button] to signal that it's safe to close the doors.
Press [button] to signal that it's safe to depart.

Well done, this train will now depart. 
Keep an eye on it as it leaves the station, then your duties for this train are complete.
You are now a platform dispatcher! Ensure passenger safety and a safe dispatch for trains leaving this platform.
You can't start dispatching as you are currently driving a service.
You can't start dispatching as you are currently in Guard Mode.
You can't start dispatching at this platform as you are still dispatching at another location. Put your equipment away and try again.
Your dispatcher session has ended as you entered Guard Mode.
Your dispatcher session has ended as you have started driving a train.
Your dispatcher session has ended as you have travelled too far away from the station.
Your next train is due to depart at {HH}:{MM}.
